summary: M.S. Computer Engineering graduate from Rochester Institute of Technology building real-time robotics systems in C++ and ROS2. Designed distributed perception-to-control pipelines with concurrent, thread-safe execution, from FreeRTOS mutex-coordinated servo control to collision-free motion planning validated on a physical UR5e. Strong in computer vision, motion planning, and low-level sensor integration for industrial robot control.

experience.title: General Secretary
bullets: Led a 25-member robotics team across national-level competitions, owning mechanical design, PCB fabrication, and AI/ML integration end-to-end.

experience.title: Research Intern (Capstone)
bullets: Architected a metal surface inspection pipeline for microscopic crack analysis via custom image stitching, wavelet denoising, and depth estimation.
Combined custom wavelet denoising with optimized homography stitching and concurrency to reach a PSNR of 86 on high-resolution reconstruction.

experience.title: Research Fellowship
bullets: Led a cross-cultural team of 7 as the sole ML-experienced student; restructured task distribution mid-project to deliver the full pipeline within a 6-week window.

projects.name: Voice-Controlled Robotic Arm (COFFIN) — MS Capstone, RIT
bullets: Built a voice-controlled, vision-guided pick-and-place system over a three-layer distributed pipeline (Flutter, edge server, Jetson+Arduino) on a WebSocket fabric; 100% pick reliability.
Implemented two-link inverse kinematics on Arduino in C++; resolved 11 integration failures across perception and motion control.

projects.name: ROS-Based Robotic Arm (AL5B & UR5e)
bullets: Planned and executed collision-free pick-and-place trajectories on a physical UR5e via the UR ROS 2 driver; AL5B repeatability measured at under 2mm over 10 trials.
Derived DH tables and forward kinematic chains for a 6-DoF UR5e and 5-DoF AL5B; validated against MoveIt and RViz URDF models in ROS 2 Humble and ROS Noetic.

projects.name: Object Tracking Turret
bullets: Used FreeRTOS with mutexes for thread-safe shared-memory task coordination; implemented multi-servo PWM control with interrupt-driven UART commands and user override.

awards: Ranked 10th, Robocon — National-level robotics competition among 45 universities (2022)
